source.note: LIVE SAMPLE, not a fixture. A snapshot of api.get_object_graph output, for looking at the picture. Nothing asserts against it; re-pull rather than edit it.

data_honesty.truncation: GH Archive caps PushEvent.commits at 20; events with attrs.truncated = true describe a push with more commits than are drawn.
data_honesty.commit_time: first-seen in PushEvent, NOT real git commit time
data_honesty.extracted_edges: Links we parsed from an unenforced human convention (branch-ref matches, commit-message references, timing proximity) render dashed with a "?" badge.
data_honesty.validated_edges: Links the platform's own data asserts (a closing keyword in the PR body, an exact SHA match) render solid.
data_honesty.commit_authorship: vmap.commit_author_name is a git identity string and is NOT joined to any GitHub account (decision 5). The actor on a CommitObserved event is the PUSHER.
